author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수만 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록
habitat: 하천, 호수, 간척지, 논, 밭, 초습지
summary: 전국의 습지와 하천에서 겨울을 나는 흔한 겨울철새다. 낮에는 하천, 호수, 간척지 등에서 쉬거나 먹이를 먹고, 밤에는 논, 밭, 초습지로 나가 먹이를 찾는다. 월동지에서는 작은 무리를 지으며, 불규칙하고 빠르게 난다. 유라시아 대륙 북부에서 번식하고 유럽 남부, 북아프리카, 중동, 남아시아에서 동아시아에 걸쳐 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Eurasian Teal (Anas crecca), adult male in winter, as seen on Korean streams and reservoirs from October to March: head chestnut with a broad, glossy dark green patch running from around the eye back to the nape, outlined by thin buff-yellow lines; breast creamy-buff with small dark spots; body finely vermiculated grey; a long horizontal white stripe, edged black below, along the side of the back above the flank; undertail coverts creamy-yellow framed by black; glossy green speculum. Small dark grey bill; dark eye; grey legs.
art.pose: resting on the water in a small flock
art.scene: Korean stream and reservoir edge in winter, shallow water beside a grassy marsh; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view swimming: chestnut head with a green eye-to-nape patch outlined in thin yellow lines, spotted creamy breast, grey body, horizontal white stripe along the side, creamy-yellow undertail framed black
adult female, side view swimming: mottled dark brown with darker markings, dark eye-stripe on a paler face, small dark bill, glossy green speculum showing at the rear of the closed wing
art.build: The smallest dabbling duck in Korea, about 38cm, clearly smaller than a Mallard (about two-thirds its length); compact and short-necked with a rounded head. Bill small, straight and narrow, shorter than the head. Legs short, grey. Tail short. Flight fast and twisting in tight flocks; the speculum is glossy green, bordered in front by a broad pale bar and behind by a narrow white trailing edge.
avoid: Do not paint a vertical white bar on the breast side — that is Green-winged Teal (Anas carolinensis); the Eurasian Teal has a horizontal white stripe.
Do not let the green cover the whole head; the head is chestnut with a green eye-band.
Do not paint a white undertail; it is creamy-yellow framed in black.
Do not draw it as large as a Mallard.
